description: react components for the binary garden

home.subtitle: react components for binary garden
home.title: one hue is the whole theme.
home.intro: every binary garden site and product is built from the same components, type, spacing and motion. our own sites, like {trunk} and this one, are black and white. each product we make for others adds one color. the rules below make that work.
home.neutralsLightNote: oklch hue 150 at chroma 0.004 — a trace of chlorophyll, so black and white read as paper and soil rather than #000 and #fff.
home.neutralsDarkNote: data-theme='dark' on <html>. the same hue with inverted lightness; borders replace shadows.
home.accentNote: --product-hue is the only thing that changes between products. the trunk sets none, so the accent is just the text colour: black in light mode, white in dark.
home.semanticNote: status only, never decorative. a semantic colour on a button that isn't reporting state is a bug.
home.displayNote: hanken grotesk, medium, tracking -0.03em, leading 1.05. text-wrap: balance on headings.
home.headingsNote: one family. hierarchy comes from size, weight and tracking — never from a second face.
home.lineLengthNote: lines of 45–75 characters read best, so headings and paragraphs cap their width in ch. the bigger the text, the shorter the line.
home.measureSample: this paragraph stops at 68ch however wide the window gets. below that it wraps with its container like any other text. code, tables, labels and one-line ui text like buttons and nav are not capped.
home.labelsNote: labels are lowercase at +0.02em tracking and use --fg-2, not --fg-3, on the page background. code uses the system mono stack.
home.spaceNote: 4px base. components use 1–6; sections use 20–24 of vertical space.
home.controlsNote: 32 / 40 / 48. every control in the system lands on one of these.
home.radiusNote: soft, not round — the radius grows with the box. shadows appear only on things that float; resting cards use a border.
home.easingNote: ease-out for most things; the spring is for entrances only, because it overshoots. reduced motion zeroes every duration.
home.hoverNote: buttons lift 1px on hover, cards 2px with a shadow. press scales to .98. reveals rise 12px and fade, staggered 60ms.
home.focusNote: a 2px accent ring offset by the page colour. inputs get a 3px soft-accent halo instead. tab through these.
home.markNote: the five-petal flower: black on light, white on dark, never recoloured or tinted with a product hue. minimum 20px. the name is set beside it in hanken grotesk 500 at -0.01em.
home.voiceNote: terse, technical, lowercase. say the thing.

gallery.title: components.
gallery.intro: flora components have no colour of their own. on BG sites, like this one, they're black and white. inside a product we build for others, they take on that product's colour. drag the hue above to try it.

core.contents: button · icon button · badge · tag · card · tooltip · avatar group
core.buttonNote: one primary per view, secondary for the rest, ghost inside dense ui, danger only for destructive confirms.
core.statesNote: loading swaps the left icon for a spinner. href renders an anchor with identical styling.
core.iconNote: always pass a label — it is the accessible name and the native tooltip. ghost by default, outline in empty areas, filled for the one accent action.
core.badgeNote: a version, a state, a count. not clickable — use a tag for that. semantic tones are for status only, never decoration.
core.tagNote: a tag either toggles or removes, never both. try both rows.
core.cardNote: cards have borders, not shadows. only interactive ones lift.
core.raisedNote: a bordered surface on the page.
core.sunkenNote: tinted, no border. for nested panels.
core.accentNote: tinted with the product's colour. use it sparingly.
core.interactiveNote: lifts 2px and gains a shadow on hover.
core.tooltipNote: dark on light (and the reverse), one short line, with an optional shortcut. the third one stays open so you can see it.
core.avatarsNote: the stack fans out on hover.
core.copyableNote: an id, a token, a secret. for multi-line code use a code block instead.

forms.inputNote: the label sits above in lowercase, the hint or error below. focus draws a 3px soft-accent halo.
forms.selectNote: use it for 4+ options; tabs or tags read better for fewer.
forms.checkboxNote: the check springs in. indeterminate is for a parent row whose children are partly selected.
forms.nightlyNote: unstable, rebuilt every night at 03:00 utc
forms.radioNote: 2–5 mutually exclusive options. more than that wants a select.
forms.switchNote: for settings that apply at once — no save button. the thumb springs and widens on press.

navigation.contents: tabs · carousel · sidebar nav · command palette · language · site header
navigation.lineNote: the active indicator is a 2px accent underline that scales in.
navigation.pillNote: segmented, on a sunken track, with the active thumb raised on a shadow.
navigation.arrowsNote: one item at a time, its neighbours small and faded either side. the arrows wrap at the ends.
navigation.pillsNote: every item at once, the current one filled. use it when the items fit on one line.
navigation.sidebarNote: the current item gets a 2px accent bar. picking an item opens its sub-items. drag the right edge to resize; keep dragging past the minimum and it fades to show it will fold to a rail; click the rail to open it again.
navigation.paletteNote: opens with ⌘K over a blurred page. use the arrow keys and enter; typing filters the list.
navigation.localeNote: moves like the theme toggle: click to open every language, pick one to close it. the app stores the choice and passes it back as value.
navigation.chromeNote: both are live on this page: the sticky header at the top and the footer at the bottom. on narrow screens the header's links fold into a menu button.

feedback.dialogNote: one decision per dialog. it scales up slightly as it opens, over a blurred page.
feedback.toastNote: appears bottom-right and rises in. the dot shows the status; the accent toast takes on the product's colour.
feedback.practiceNote: a real modal, a toast that disappears on its own, and confirm/prompt/alert dialogs you can open from code.
feedback.publishNote: this pushes 0.1.0 to npm and cannot be undone.

marketing.heroNote: headlines are at most 8 words, one idea, and end with a period. wrap a phrase in <em> to tint it with the accent. the parts stagger in by 60ms.
marketing.heroSubtitle: a community of technical creatives building free software that shares one design language.
marketing.tileLabel: where colour shows up on BG sites
marketing.tileNote: each tile carries its product's colour, and everything inside it uses that colour. with no image, the tile shows the product's initials.

loam.tagline: a roadmap in a text file

marketing.codeNote: code uses the system mono stack — code is content, not brand. the copy button flashes the accent.
marketing.noHeader: no header, just a floating copy button

icons.contents: 26 bespoke marks. 1.5px stroke, currentColor, 16px inline and 18px in icon buttons. no icon font, no emoji.
